decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Design and access statement, STG-01, STG-02, STG-03, STG-06, received on 25/06/2012 and STG-04 REV C and STG-05 REV C, received on 16/08/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The existing crossover must be reinstated as footway/grass verge before the construction of the front boundary wall commences.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, two storey side extension, new porch and new front boundary wall to the house
